mentions.name: opendocs.to
mentions.description: This web service lets users channel public Google Docs through human-friendly custom URLs, redirecting links like opendocs.to/your-name/resume to the underlying docs.google.com address. Built with Vite/React, Node, and Postgres in Docker, with nginx serving traffic (built inside containers locally, proxying to containers in production). Currently a free tier while final tweaking is done.
mentions.problem: Google Docs share links are long and unwieldy; this provides nicer, natural-sounding URLs for sharing documents.
mentions.source_excerpt:
It's web service that allows you to channel your google docs through a more human-friendly name. So, you link

opendocs.to/your-name/resume (an example link)

to your public resume at docs.google.com/dlkjbalksdfd

It's a simple redirect service, but it just looks nicer
